content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Reno

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a four-year degree, associate degree, or high-school diploma—and calculate your qualifying work hours. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your profile at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Reno-based trainers deliver the PMI-required 35 contact hours over a flexible schedule, covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-style questions. Attend synchronously from your office or home—no self-paced modules or recordings.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, file your official application with PMI. Document your project-management experience, education, and training completion. Once PMI approves your application, you'll receive your exam authorization and payment instructions for the credential exam fee.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take Your Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation workshops, practice tests, and one-on-one guidance to sharpen your readiness. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center in the Reno area or test remotely. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you hold the PMP® for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn and report Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, speaking, or publishing. PMI's three-year cycle ensures your knowledge stays current with evolving project-management practices and industry standards.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
